notes.title: Update on the Game’s Development
notes.notes:
These past few weeks have been pretty rough. I spent several days trying to fix some bugs and, at the same time, decided to improve ALL of the cutscene artwork — both with and without dialogue.

At the beginning of the month, I was really happy to have finally reached the final act of the game. But now that I’m reworking so much of the artwork, I had to go back to the very beginning, taking several steps back before I can move forward again.

Taking advantage of this decision, I’m also adding new scenes and making some important changes. Even though I’m happy with the improvements I’ve made so far, there’s still a lot to finish, which means I’ll be “stuck” in Acts 1 and 2 for a while longer.

My plan has always been to release the game this year (2025), but with these changes — plus the return of classes, my thesis, and my internship — honestly, I’m starting to have doubts about the release date. Still, I’ll keep giving my best to make sure the game launches in 2025 and deliver the best game possible!

Next month (August), I should update the demo with these new changes.



Thank you,
Justo Dias
